title: The Sickpools
summary: Pim Rushlight says the old vats in the Sickpools are being drained by night, and he'd know: he buys what comes out. The Cult's harvesters are down there filling their cages.

steps.journal: Go into the Sickpools and break three full lantern-cages. Only the harvesters who lead the others carry a full one.

ready: Three cages broken. Tell Pim, at his handcart by Saltmere's cistern.
done: Pim counted the broken cages on his fingers twice and said his oil would be dearer now. He didn't sound sorry.
